operations.command:
set -e; target=/mnt; test "$(hostname)" = nixos-recovery; bootctl status | grep -F 'Secure Boot: enabled'; test -x /run/current-system/sw/bin/btrfs; test -x /run/current-system/sw/bin/cryptsetup; test -x /run/current-system/sw/bin/nixos-mount; nixos-mount --help | grep -F 'Usage: nixos-mount'; printf 'testpass123
' | nixos-mount "$target"; findmnt -rn --target "$target/etc/nixos" | grep -F '@persist/dirs/etc!nixos'; findmnt -rn --target "$target/var" | grep -F '@var'; findmnt -rn --target "$target/home" | grep -F '@home'; test "$(findmnt -no FSTYPE "$target/boot")" = vfat; test "$(findmnt -no FSTYPE "$target/recovery")" = vfat; nixos-mount "$target" >/tmp/nixos-mount-second.log; test -d "$target/nix/store"; test -d "$target/etc/nixos/.git"; printf recovery-secure-boot-ok

set -e; target=/mnt; test "$(hostname)" = nixos-recovery; mountpoint -q "$target/boot"; mountpoint -q "$target/recovery"; cd "$target/etc/nixos"; TMPDIR=/tmp nixos-install --root "$target" --flake "$target/etc/nixos#VM-TEST-Secure-Boot" --no-channel-copy --show-trace --no-root-password --max-jobs auto --cores 0; sbverify=$(find "$target/nix/store" -path '*/bin/sbverify' -type f | head -1); sbverify=${sbverify#$target}; case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) fallback=BOOTX64.EFI ;; aarch64) fallback=BOOTAA64.EFI ;; *) fallback=BOOTUNKNOWN.EFI ;; esac; for file in /boot/EFI/recovery/nixos-recovery.efi /recovery/EFI/recovery/nixos-recovery.efi /recovery/EFI/BOOT/$fallback; do chroot "$target" "$sbverify" --cert /var/lib/sbctl/keys/db/db.pem "$file"; done; printf recovery-mounted-reinstall-ok
set -e; test "$(hostname)" = nixos-recovery; bootctl status | grep -F "Secure Boot: enabled"; echo recovery-firmware-fallback-ok
